name: video_generation
description: Create mp4 videos from text and optional image, video, or audio references through agent-gw.
author: Moonshot AI
skillInstructions: Use the video_generation skill when the user wants AI video generation from a text description, optionally guided by reference media. Build a detailed, descriptive prompt; pick a supported ratio (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16, 21:9), resolution (480p or 720p, default 720p), and duration between 4 and 12 seconds. Convert any local reference image, video, or audio file to a public URL through agent-gw first; do not background the conversion commands. Reference limits are at most 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio files. Start the generate command with nohup and redirect it to a log file, then start scripts/video_generation_watch.py directly in the foreground (without nohup or &) to check that log every minute and keep the sandbox alive until generation succeeds or fails. The watcher has no timeout, so set the outer command-execution timeout to at least 15 minutes. If the outer execution times out while generation is pending, restart only the foreground watcher with the same log file; never start a duplicate generate command. Wait for the watcher to exit before reporting the result, and do not fabricate a video or a local path when the call fails.

interface.shortDescription: Generate mp4 videos from text and reference media
interface.longDescription: Create an mp4 video based on a text description and optional reference media. Supports aspect ratios 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16, and 21:9; resolutions 480p and 720p (default 720p); and durations from 4 to 12 seconds. Reference limits are 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio files. Results are saved locally as mp4 files.
